result.summary: A narrow residential street lined with row houses and sidewalks on both sides. The environment lacks basic pedestrian safety infrastructure at the intersection, such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and daylighting to improve visibility.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked immediately adjacent to the intersection corners block sightlines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground corners on both the left and right sides of the street.

hazards.name: Lack of Accessible Infrastructure
hazards.description: The absence of curb ramps makes the crossing difficult or impossible for people with mobility aids or strollers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style painted crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space and alert drivers to crossing points.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and physically prevent parking that obstructs sightlines.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install compliant curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces to ensure universal accessibility.

result.summary: A narrow residential street with sidewalks on both sides but lacking marked pedestrian crossings or traffic control devices. Utility poles and parked vehicles create minor obstructions and potential visibility issues for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles are located in the middle of the sidewalk on the right, narrowing the effective walking path.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no visible marked crosswalks, forcing pedestrians to cross in unmarked areas without priority.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks at intersections to define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add curb extensions at corners to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a wide, well-maintained sidewalk that is interrupted by a large, two-lane parking garage entrance. The lack of clear markings or signage at this conflict point creates potential risks for pedestrians crossing the driveway due to vehicle movements.

hazards.name: Driveway Conflict Zone
hazards.description: A wide two-lane garage entrance crosses the sidewalk without markings, creating a conflict point between pedestrians and vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground where the sidewalk meets the garage ramp.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: The concrete walls flanking the garage ramp may obstruct the view between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers exiting the garage.
hazards.location_in_image: Walls on either side of the garage entrance ramp.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalk
interventions.description: Paint a high-visibility crosswalk across the driveway to clearly define the pedestrian right-of-way and alert drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Warning Signage
interventions.description: Install signs for exiting drivers to watch for pedestrians and for pedestrians to watch for exiting vehicles.

interventions.title: Audible/Visual Exit Warnings
interventions.description: Install sensors that trigger flashing lights or sounds when a vehicle is exiting the garage to alert pedestrians on the sidewalk.

result.summary: The street features a wide, well-maintained sidewalk on the left side adjacent to a modern residential building, but lacks basic pedestrian crossing infrastructure. There are no marked crosswalks or visible traffic control devices at the intersection, and parked vehicles on the right side may create sightline issues.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks, which fails to designate a clear path for pedestrians or alert drivers to their presence.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection of Redfield St and the main roadway

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked cars along the right side of the street near the intersection can block the view between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway near the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers.
